interest: Shows US tracking of Adm. Osami Nagano's April 1941 appointment as Navy Chief of Staff, who later approved Pearl Harbor.
overview: Docket (1941) on Japanese Navy personnel: Grew's report on Adm. Nagano replacing Prince Fushimi as Naval Chief of Staff, attaché reports on flag officers, and a Welles memo directing a draft reply.

subfiles.about: A Department of State docket sheet summarizing communications received between April and November 1941 regarding Japanese Navy personnel and leadership appointments.
